# Krizaka

> Krizaka is a Montréal (Québec) software studio building open-source,
> production-ready platforms where compliance, security and modularity are
> enforced in code. Three products — two running today, one coming soon — every
> repository public under Apache-2.0 at https://github.com/krizaka.

## Products

- Orazaka — sovereign, on-premise AI orchestration engine (chat, RAG, agents,
  image, audio, video) on a hexagonal architecture (Java 21, Spring Boot 4,
  Spring AI 2) enforced by ArchUnit. Law 25 / GDPR compliant by design: data
  never leaves your network. Split into one repository per component so other
  applications reuse users, notifications, billing, the edge and the UI kit.
- Orochia — open-source video platform for independent creators (adult-friendly,
  18+), live at {{OROCHIA_APP_URL}}: direct-to-CDN streaming with 5-minute signed
  URLs; per-video audiences (followers, contacts, paid unlock with a minimum,
  invited people and reusable private lists); collections with permissions;
  views, likes, comments and shares; gateway-confirmed payments settled exactly
  once into a double-entry ledger; 18 U.S.C. § 2257 creator verification.
- Yazakia (coming soon, not released yet) — a mobile dating app (iOS and
  Android) where you talk first: an AI agent gets to know you, then opens a
  small batch of 3 to 5 people compatible in both directions, with written
  reasons and never a score; the next batch waits for a short debrief; mutual
  interest opens a seven-day intro the agent never reads. Location rounded to
  ~1 km, sensitive answers encrypted at rest, account deletion in the app.
